title: Uyu nawe baramwivuganye da! Haracyari urujijo ku rupfu rwa Padiri Karekezi Dominique wari Umuyobozi wa Kaminuza ya INATEK
content:
Padiri Karekezi Dominique wari Umuyobozi wa Kaminuza ya INATEK yatabarutse ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 10 Kanama 2015, bivugwa ko yaba yishwe n’abagizi ba nabi mu gihe hari n’abandi bavuga ko yazize uburwayi.

Inkuru y’urupfu rwa Padiri Karekezi yamenyekanye kuri uyu wa Mbere ahagana saa mbili z’ijoro, aho ngo yasanzwe mu icumbi yabagamo yapfuye. Kugeza ubu nta mpamvu nyakuri y’urupfu rw’uyu mupadiri iremezwa na muganga kuko umurambo we wajyanywe gupimwa mu bitaro bikuru bya Polisi ku Kacyiru.

Ahagana saa yine z’ijoro, abantu bagera kuri mirongo itatu barimo n’abihayimana bari ku bitaro bikuru bya Kacyiru aho umubiri w’uyu mupadiri uri gupimirwa. Aba bantu bari bisunganye mu matsinda baganira ariko ku maso bigaragara ko bumiwe ndetse bababajwe no kwakira iyo nkuru y’incamugongo.

Umwe mu bo mu muryango wa Padiri Karekezi, yabwiye IGIHE ko nabo bari kumva urujijo ku rupfu rw’ uyu mupadiri, kuko hashidikanywa ku cyaba cyamwishe bishobora kuba abagizi ba nabi cyangwa uburwayi.

Abo mu muryango we bavuga ko ari yo mpamvu yatumye umurambo we wahise ujyanwa igitaraganya mu bitaro ngo hakorwe isuzuma. Yagize ati ”Iyo aza kuba yari arwaye uru rujijo ntiruba ruhari. Nta ndwara ye nzi, ntabwo yigeze arwara. Ariko reka ntashyiramo amarangamutima, ubwo ni ugutegereza icyemezo cya muganga.”

Yavuze ko bategereje umwanzuro wa muganga, uramenyekana kuri uyu wa Kabiri saa tatu. Bivugwa ko Padiri Karekezi wigeze kuba umuyobozi wa Kinyamateka yasanzwe mu cyumba yabagamo mu ntara y’Iburasirazuba yapfuye, ngo ndetse afite n’igikomere mu mutwe.

title: Kumenya ko umwana wavutse ku mubyeyi urwaye S...
content:
Elizabeth Glaser Pediatric AIDS Foundation barishimira imyaka 19 bamaze bafasha ababyeyi n’abana bavukanye ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera SIDA aho kuri ubu umwana uvukanye ubwandu abimenya mu munsi umwe gusa mu gihe mbere byasabaga hagati y’iminsi 30 na 56.

Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 20/06/2019 muri Kigali Marriott Hotel habereye umuhango wo kwizihiza isabukuru y'imyaka 19 umuryango Elizabeth Glaser Pediatric AIDS Foundation (EGPAF) umaze ufasha ababyeyi n'abana bavukanye agakoko gatera SIDA. FUNDI Rose Angelique, umwe mu baganga bakora muri EGPAF avuga ko bishimye cyane ko kugeza ubu impfu z’abana bapfa bavukanye ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera SIDA zagabanutse bitewe n’uko umwana ugize ibyago byo kuvukana ubwandu akurikiranwa hakiri kare kuko ibisubizo bibonekera igihe ndetse agahita ashyirwa ku miti ako kanya bityo akabasha kubaho mu gihe ubundi byasabaga nibura hagati y’iminsi 30 na 56 kugira ngo umubyeyi amenye ko umwana we yanduye, ibyo rero byatumaga ubwandu bw’umwana bwiyongera bityo akaba yanapfa.

Umwe mu babyeyi bafite ubwandu ndetse ufite umwana wavukanye ubwandu n’abandi bavutse ari bazima arahamya ko iyi gahunda yageze ku ntego yayo. Mu buhamya bwe yagize ati”Ndi umubyeyi w’abana 3 umuhungu umwe n’abakobwa babiri, umukuru afite imyaka 12, umukurikiye afite 11, umuto afite amezi 10, mfite imyaka 42 kandi mbana n’ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera SIDA. Namenye ko nanduye muri 2005 nkibimenya ntibyanshimishije byarambabaje ndabyihererana, 2007 nsama inda kandi ndwaye ndabyihererana ndinda ngera ku mezi 9 ntaripimisha kuko ntashakaga ko hari ubimenya, maze kubyara basanga umwana afite ubwandu ariko ntiyahise afata imiti gusa ubu arayifata nubwo ataramenya ko arwaye kuko sindabona imbaraga zo kubimuganiriza ngo mubwire ko arwaye.

Nakomeje kubaho rero nza guhagarika imiti kuko abayitangaga bampaye servise mbi mara umwaka wose ntayifata gusa naje gusubira ku muronga mfata imiti ubu nta kibazo mfite rwose. Naje kongera kubyara umwana wa kabiri nkurikije amabwiriza ya muganga umwana avuka ari muzima cyakora ibisubizo byaje bitinzeho gato kuko ntibyari byakajya ku murongo. Vuba ha rero naje kubyara undi mwana ubu afite amezi 10 ariko ibisubizo by’uko ari muzima nabihawe ako kanya ndashimira ababigizemo uruhare kugirango mbashe kubona ibisubizo by’umwana wanjye ndetse menye uko mukurikirana.”

Uyu munsi wa none nta mwana ugipfa gupfa kuko umubyeyi we atamenye ko yanduye, umubyeyi wanduye akimara kubyara, umwana ahita akurikiranwa basanga yaranduye agashyirwa ku miti, mu gihe ubusanzwe umwana wavukanaga ubwandu ntibamenye ko yanduye ntiyarenzaga imyaka ibiri akiriho. Fondation Elizabeth glaser pediatric aids rero iri mu byishimo bikomeye kuko isa n’iyageze ku ntego yayo yo kugabanya impfu z’abana bagiraga ibyago byo kuvukana ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera SIDA.

title: Itangazo rigenewe abahanzi bafite ibihangano...
content:
Ubuyobozi bwa Inyarwanda Ltd buramenyesha abahanzi bose bafite ibihangano byabo ku rubuga rwa www.inyarwanda.com kuza kuzuza imyorondoro yabo bakanasobanurirwa imikoreshereze mishya y'uru rubuga kuko hari serivisi nshya rwabageneye zizajya zibafasha kurukoresha mu buhanzi bwabo.

Nyuma y’aho urubuga rwa www.inyarwanda.com rushyiriye ahagaragara igishushanyo gishya (Design) mu buryo amakuru n’izindi serivise zitangirwaho bikorwa, harimo no kuba hari uburyo umuhanzi azajya ashobora gushyira ku rubuga amafoto ye bwite, kungurana ibitekerezo n’abakunzi babo n’ibindi.

Ibi kugira ngo bikunde, bikaba bisaba ko hari imyirondoro abafite ibihangano kuri uru rubuga buzuza kugirango babashe gukoresha izi serivise mu buryo buboroheye. Mu byo basabwa hakaba harimo nka E-Mails zabo n’ibindi aho nyuma bahabwa umubare w’ibanga bazajya bakoresha.

Nyuma yo kuzuza iyi myirondoro, buri muhanzi, akazabasha Kwishyirira amafoto ye ku rubuga, amagambo y’indirimbo ze (Lyrics), kuzuza imyirondoro n’ubuzima bwe bwa gihanzi ndetse no kungurana ibitekerezo anaganira n’abakunzi be ku rubuga.

Kugeza ubu, abahanzi bose bakaba basabwa kuza kuzuza iyi myirondoro aho Inyarwanda Ltd ikorera mu nyubako ya La Bonne Adresse iherereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali haruguru gato ya UTC.

Ku bahanzi bari hanze y’igihugu, bashobora kohereza imyirondoro yabo iriho na kopi y’ibyangombwa byabo (Indangamuntu cyangwa Passport), bakoheroherezwa kuba nabo bakoresha uru rubuga na serivisi nshya zarwo. Mukohereza ubu butumwa bakaba bakoresha email ikurikira: inyarwanda3@gmail.com .

title: Nahisemo kuririmba kuko kuvuga ubutumwa mu ij...
content:
Umuvugabutumwa Mutabaruka Fulgence avuga ko yahisemo kuba umuhanzi mu ndirimbo zihimbaza Imana nyuma yo gusanga bidahagije kuvuga ubutumwa mu ijambo gusa ndetse ngo yumvaga ubwo butumwa butagera henshi nk’uko abyifuza.

Nyuma y’amezi atatu gusa amaze mu muziki dore ko yawinjiyemo mu kwezi kwa Kamena 2015, Mutabaruka Fulgence yateguye igitaramo cyo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana kizaba kuri iki cyumweru tariki ya 23 Kanama 2015 ku itorero Evangelical Restoration rya Nyacyonga kuva isaa munani z’amanywa kugeza saa kumi n’ebyiri.

Mu kiganiro na inyarwanda.com, Mutabaruka Fulgence uhamya ko bitajya bimworohera kumara igihe adakora ivugabutumwa haba mu kuririmba ndetse no mu ijambo, muri icyo gitaramo cye azaba ari kumwe na Liliane Kabaganza, Eric Bobo, Isaie Uzayisenga, Torero, Blessing choir, Goshen Family singers n’abandi.

Mutabaruka Fulgence umukristo mu itorero rya Evangelical Restoration Nyacyonga, avuga ko iyo yandika indirimbo agendera ku cyanditswe kiri muri Matayo 10;7 harimo amagambo avuga ngo “Mugende mubabwire ko ubwami bw’Imana bwegereje”. Mu rwego rwo gusakaza ubutumwa bwiza ahantu hose, Mutabaruka yaje kurenga imbibi, yinjira mu buhanzi bw’indirimbo zihimbaza Imana kugeza ubu akaba abifatanya no kuvuga ubutumwa mu ijambo.

Umuhanzi akaba n'umuvugabutumwa Mutabaruka Fulgence

Mutabaruka avuga ko mu Rwanda akunda cyane umuhanzi Israel Mbonyi. Abajijwe impamvu ariwe akunda cyane kurusha abandi, Mutabaruka yavuze ko Israel Mbonyi aririmba adashakisha ndetse agakora ibintu bimurimo.

title: AERG ubutaka bahawe na Perezida ntibwapfuye ubusa, barahinga bakorora
content:
Umuyobozi ku rwego rw’igihugu w’Umuryango w’abanyeshuri barokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi biga mu mashuri yisumbuye na Kaminuza (AERG), Emmanuel Muneza avuga ko umusaruro uva ku matungo (inka n’ihene) bagabiwe na Perezida Paul Kagame ubafasha mu kwikemurira ibibazo, ntibakomeze kugora Ikigega gitera inkunga abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi (FARG).

Ariya matungo yororewe mu rwuri ruri mu Kagari ka Karama, Umurenge wa Karangazi mu Karere ka Nyagatare. Agizwe n’inka 91 n’ihene 105.

Ziriya nka zatanzwe na Mme Jeannette Kagame, ingabo z’u Rwanda, abanyamuryango ba AERG n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa.

Amatungo afite ubutaka bwisanzuye yahukiramo, aba mu biraro bya kijyambere, akagira amabuga ashokamo ndetse n’abaganga bayitaho.

Umuryango w’abanyeshuri barokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi biga amashuri yisumbuye na Kaminuza, bafite isambu ya hegitari 130, muri zo izirenga 60 zikorerwaho ubuhinzi bwa kijyambere.

Emmanuel Muneza uyobora AERG ku rwego rw’igihugu yabwiye Umuseke ko iriya sambu ari umurage w’umuryango wa Perezida Kagame Paul wo kugira ngo na bo bace akenge, bawubyaze umusaruro.

Avuga ko batamutengushye ahubwo bakora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo umusaruro uva muri iriya mitungo, ube ufatika kandi ubunganire mu bikorwa bigenerwa abanyamuryango.

Ati “Umukamo tuwushyira amakusanyirizo nk’abandi borozi bose ariko iyo urutoki rweze turagurisha tugakuramo hafi miliyoni 5 Frw. Aya atwunganira mu gufasha abavandimwe bacu bagize ibibazo byihariye, ntiduhore tugondoza Ikigega FARG.”

Muneza avuga ko hari imishinga ishamikiye kuri Minisiteri y’Ubuhinzi n’Ubworozi bari gukorana kugira ngo ibikorerwa muri iriya sambu yabo bizarusheho gutanga umusaruro kandi ibe isambu y’ikitegererezo mu Rwanda ku bashaka gukora ubuhinzi n’ubworozi.

title: Amafoto adasanzwe utigeze ubona agaragaza Barack Obama n’umuryango we
content:
Uwabaye umufotogarafe wa Barack Obama, yashyize hanze amafoto atandukanye agaragaza ubuzima bwa Obama abantu batigeze bamenya.

Barack Hussein Obama yabaye Perezida wa 44 wa Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika kuva muri 2009 kugeza 2017 asimbuwe na Donald Trump.

Mugihe uyu mugabo yabaye muri uyu mwanya wo kuyobora iki gihugu cy’igihangange, yishimiwe na benshi kubera uburyo yakunze kwigaragaza yicishije bugufi.

Callie Shell umufotogarafe wabanye cyane na Obama ndetse akaba ari nawe wari ushinzwe gufata amafoto y’umuryango we, yashyize hanze amafoto adasanzwe agaragaza Barack Obama n’umuryango we mubihe bitandukanye.

Barack Obam yashakanye na Michelle Robinson Obama mu mwaka 1992, bafitanye abana babiri b’abakobwa aribo Malia Ann Obama na Natasha Obama.

title: Hagiye kuba inama idasanzwe y'ihuriro ry'abak...
content:
Hari gutegurwa inama yo mu rwego rwo hejuru y’abakristu bigira hamwe uko bakora ivugabutumwa aho bakorera hatandukanye. Muri iyo nama kandi nibwo hazatangizwa ku mugaragaro ihuriro ry’abo bakristu, ryiswe CAMP: (Christ Ambassadors in the market place) mu magambo arambuye.

Iyo nama iteganyijwe itariki ya 1 y’ukwa karindwi, izahuza byibura abakristu 500 bakora ahantu hatandukanye. Ikaba igamije gufasha kubahuriza hamwe ngo bigire hamwe uko bakora ivugabutumwa aho bakorera batarinze kuva mu kazi ngo bakorere mu nsengero. Pasteri Jimmy Muyango ukuriye komite itegura iyo nama, yadutangarije ko abakristu bamara umwanya munini aho bakorera kurenza ahandi hantu hose bityo akaba ari naho bagomba gukorera umurimo w’Imana bitabangamiye akazi bakora.

Iri huriro CAMP rizaba rihuriwemo n’abakristu bakomotse mu nsengero zitandukanye bakaba bateganya ibikorwa byinshi birimo guterana mu masaha y’ikiruhuko mu kazi, ibiterane ngarukamwaka, gukorana n’insengero mu gutegura abakristu babo mu gihe bagiye mu kazi, kwigisha ndetse harimo no gutegura ibikorwa by’ubukorerabushake hagamijwe kwamamaza Ijambo ry’Imana.

Muri iyo nama izabera kuri Sport View Hotel abo bakristu bazaganirizwa na Pasiteri Antoine Rutayisire uzwi cyane muri gahunda zitandukanye z’abakristu zigamije kuzana impinduka ndetse n’umu pasiteri ukomoka mu gihugu cya Kenya witwa John Nganga umwanditsi w’ibitabo ndetse akaba akunda no gutanga ibiganiro. Ibyo biganiro bikazaba bishingiye ku nsanganyamatsiko ivuga ngo “abe ariko imyifatire yanyu ishimwa n’abantu kugirangi ibikorwa byanyu byiza biheshe icyubahiro So wo mu ijuru” Matayo 5:16

Iyi nama rero yo gutangiza iri huriro ije mu gihe hari hamaze igihe kinini abakristu batandukanye bibaza uburyo bakorera Imana mu gihe batangiye akazi kuko baba batakibasha kubona umwanya wo gukorera mu nsengero nkuko baba babikora iyo bakiri abanyeshuri.

title: Amakorali arenga 30 agiye guhurira mu giteran...
content:
Mu Rwanda hateguwe igiterane mpuzamakorali, kizatangira kuva ku itariki 09/12 kugeza kuri 14/12/2014, aho kugeza ubu biteganyijwe ko amakorali agera kuri 30 azahurira hamwe ku itorero rya Bethesda Holy Church(Gisozi) bagatarama ariko kandi bagaruka ku nsanganyamatsiko igira iti “Ubumwe bwacu, imbaraga z’itorero rya Kiristu.”

Ni mu rwego rwo kwifatanya n’isi yose kwizihiza umunsi mukuru mpuzamahanga w’Amakorali wizihizwa mu cyumweru cya kabiri cy’ukwezi k’ukuboza.Uyu munsi ukaba waratangiye kwizihizwa kuva mu mwaka w’1990 gusa mu Rwanda hakaba hashize imyaka ibiri gusa uyu munsi utangiye kwizihizwa ndetse akaba ari ku nshuro ya kabiri igitaramo nk’iki giteguwe hizihizwa uyu munsi.

Nk’uko twabitangarijwe na Emile Rutagengwa umuyobozi mukuru w’ihuriro ry’amakorali mu Rwanda ryitwa ‘United Gospel Forum’ ari nayo itegura iki giterane, yavuze ko kugeza ubu imyiteguro imeze neza ndetse mu makorali 30 bifuje kubana nayo, agera kuri 20 yamaze kwemera ubu butumire hakaba hari icyizere ko n’abandi bazahagaragara.

Emile Rutagengwa avuga ko n’ubwo batinze kumenya ibijyanye n’uyu munsi mukuru w’amakorali, aho babimenyeye bifuje gutanga umusanzu wabo mu gufasha umuryango wa gikiristo n’umuryango nyarwanda muri rusange bategura iki giterane ngarukamwaka bazajya bahura bakaganira, bakagerageza gushakira hamwe umuti w’ibibazo no kunga ubumwe baharanira amahoro n’iterambere.

Kugeza ubu amakorali arimo Rehoboth ministries, Alarm ministries, True promises, Musingi choir, Light gospel choir,injiri bora n’izindi ziteguye kuzahurira muri iki gitaramo aho bizaba ari n’umwanya mwiza wo kwimika Ubumwe, amahoro n’Urukundo mu makorali n’umuryango nyarwanda muri rusange.

title: PGGSS6:Bruce Melodie yashimiye Imana n'abafit...
content:
Umuhanzi Bruce Melodie ni umwe mu bahatanira irushanwa rya PGGSS6, ni umwe mubahabwa amahirwe yo kwegukana iri rushanwa, ubwo yabazwaga kubijyanye n’igitaramo kizabera mu karere ka Ngoma Bruce Melodie yahisemo gufata umwanya ashimira Imana anashimira abantu b’ingenzi mu buzima bwe.

Mu kiganiro Inyarwanda.com yagiranye na Bruce Melodie, yabajijwe uko yumva yiteguye igitaramo kigomba kubera mu karere ka Ngoma tariki 18 Kamena 2016, aho abahanzi 10 bahatanira igikombe cya PGGSS6 bazataramira maze uyu musore aboneraho guhamya ko yumva ameze neza cyane ndetse ko yiteguye kongera gushimisha abakunzi ba muzika nyarwanda nkuko yabikoze mu bitaramo byabanje.

Muri iki kiganiro na Inyarwanda.com, Bruce Melodie yasabye umunyamakuru ko yamuha umwanya agashimira Imana ikomeje kumurinda ikamuhundagazaho imigisha mu kazi ke ka buri munsi ariko muzika. Aha Bruce Melodie yagize ati

”Mfashe uyu mwanya ngo nshimire Imana, njye njya nyuzamo nkibuka ibihe bya cyera, byari bigoye ko numva ko nzaba uwo ndiwe ubu ariko byose ndahamya ko ari Imana niyo mpamvu ntazatezuka kuyishimira kuko yankoreye ibidasanzwe ku buzima bwanjye.”

Ishimwe ku Mana, ku babyeyi n'abavandimwe, kunshuti ndetse n'abafana be niryo Bruce Melodie ari kugendana

Usibye gushimira Imana Bruce Melodie yafashe umwanya ashimira ababyeyi be nubwo bitabye Imana ashimira n’abavandimwe be badahwema kumuba hafi bakamuha urukundo rwa kivandimwe. Aha Melodie yagize ati” Ngira ngo mujya mubyumva ko hari abavuga ko umuvandimwe wo muri iyi minsi arutwa n’inshuti nziza gusa njye nshimira abavandimwe banjye ko nta na rimwe baratuma natekereza gutyo kuko bamba hafi uko bashobojwe kose pe.”

Yashimiye abafite amazina akomeye hano mu Rwanda

Nyuma yo gushimira ababyeyi be n’abavandimwe Bruce Melodie yahise atangira gushimira abantu banyuranye,ashimira n'abafite amazina akomeye hano mu Rwanda, ati”Ndashimira abantu bafite amazina akomeye hano mu Rwanda bagiye banyereka ko hari byinshi mvuze kuri muzika yacu aha navuga nka Uncle Austin, The Ben,Kitoko,Haruna Niyonzima n'abandi benshi bagiye bagaragaza kunshyigikira mu muziki wanjye.”

Bruce Melodie agerageza gukoresha imbaraga nyinshi kurubyiniro ngo yiteguye no kuzereka abanye Ngoma

Usibye abantu bafite amazina akomeye bamuba hafi uyu muhanzi yashimiye kandi yavuze ko bwa mbere abo ashimira yivuye inyuma ari abafana be badahwema kumuba hafi, ati:

”Abafana banjye ni bamwe mubagira uruhare mu iterambere rya muzika yanjye kuko nibo banyobora inzira yo kunyuramo. Bamba hafi igihe cyose ni inkoramutima zanjye, aba nibamwe mubo nshingiraho mpamya ko ntacyo ntageraho mu gihe nkibafite nk’intwaro zanjye.”

Uyu muhanzi yashoje ikiganio yagiranye na Inyarwanda.com ashimangira ko abafana b’umuziki nyarwanda baba i Ngoma bashonje bahishiwe kuko hari byinshi byiza yiteze kubereka muri iki gitaramo we agahamya ko Ngoma ari hamwe muho agomba kwerekanira ko igikombe cya PGGSS6 agifitiye inyota kandi ko agikwiye.

title: Imvura ikomeje kubica bigacika mu ntara y’amajyaruguru
content:
Imvura mu ntara y’amajyaruguru ikomeje kwangiza ibintu itaretse guhitana ubuzima bw’abantu.

Mu gice cy’u Rwanda intara y’amajyaruguru, nubwo muri rusanjye hamaze iminsi hagwa imvura, iyaguye murukerera rwo kuri iki cyumweru taliki ya 8 gicurasi ngo ntiyari imvura isanzwe.

Iyi mvura yibasiye akarere ka Gakenke yahitanye abantu 20, bikavugwa ko imibare ishobora kwiyongera, Hari n’abakomeretse, si ubuzima bw’abantu gusa kandi kuko hanangiritse byinshi byaba ibikorwa remezo, inzu, imyaka y’abaturage n’ibindi yasanze bitandukanye.

Inkangu zatumye umuhanda kigari musanze ufungwa kuva ibi byaba, imodoka ziva Kigali zijya musanze bivugwa ko zahisemo gukoresha umuhanda unyura Muhanga werekeza ngororero kuko zitashoboraga kubona aho zinyura, uretse imodoka n’abantu ubwabo gutambuka byari ingorabahizi.

Umuhanda wafunzwe n’inkangu, ni igice gito cya buranga uva mu isantere y’ubucuruzi ya Gakenke uzamuka naho ahibasiwe n’iyi mvura ikanatwara ubuzima bw’abantu ni mu mirenge ya Gakenke, Mugunga ndetse na Mataba.

title: Muhanga/Kabgayi: Abaturage bambuye Ibitaro barabahamagara ngo bishyure ‘bagakuraho telefoni’
content:
Abakozi b’Ibitaro bya Kabgayi babwiye Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyepfo Kayitesi Alice ko Ibitaro bifite imyenda ituruka ku barwayi bazanwa kuvuzwa badafite ubwishingizi, hakiyongeraho na miliyoni zisaga 40Frw ahembwa abakozi bagengwa n’amasezerano.

Ibi babigiye mu nama yabahuje n’Inzego zo mu Ntara y’Amajyepfo, ndetse n’Akarere ka Muhanga, yabaye ku mugoroba wo ku wa Gatanu taliki ya 19 Werurwe 2021 i Kabgayi.

Ni inama igamije kureba uko hanozwa serivisi ihabwa abarwayi, hakanarebwa uburyo ibi Bitaro byakwihaza ku mutungo bibona.

Abakozi b’Ibitaro bavuga ko hari ideni rya miliyoni zurenga 100 zirebana n’inyemezabwishyu (Factures) zigaragaza umubare w’amafaranga abarwayi batagira mutuweli barimo. Hari abazanwe mu Bitaro baratoroka, abandi bagasinya ko bazayishyura bageze mu ngo.

Aba bakozi kandi bavuga ko iki gihombo cyari gikwiriye kwirengerwa n’Akarere kubera ko ari ko kaboherereza abo barwayi.

Rukundo Jerôme Umukozi w’ibitaro bya Kabgayi ushinzwe kwishyuza, ati: ”Iyo duhamagaye abo bantu batubereyemo imyenda, bakuraho telefoni, cyangwa bakatubwira ko twibeshye.”

Rukundo na bagenzi be bifuje ko Akarere kashyira aba baturage mu byiciro by’Ubudehe bibakwiriye kuko ari byo bizatuma abagana ibitaro babasha kwivuza no kwishyura mu buryo bworoshye.

Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ibitaro bya Kabgayi, Dr Nteziryayo Philippe yavuze ko kuri iyi myenda bafitiwe n’abaturage, hiyongeraho n’igikoresho basuzumiraho abarwayi (Radiographie) ndetse n’uburuhukiro bumwe budakora, hakaba hashize igihe kinini.

Cyakora akavuga ko hari abatekinisiye Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yohereje gukora icyuma cya Radiyographie.

Yagize ati: ”Usibye ibyo tuvuze hari kandi na zimwe mu nyubako zishaje zikwiriye gusanwa.”

Nteziryayo yanavuze ko bafite imbogamizi zo kuba bafite abakozi benshi bagengwa n’amasezerano, kuko baruta abakozi Leta ihemba buri kwezi, akifuza ko Ubuyobozi bwabafasha gushakira hamwe igisubizo cy’aba bakozi kugira ngo badahagarara abarwayi bakabura ababitaho kuko bakenewe.

Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyepfo Kayitesi Alice, yabwiye aba bakozi ko bagiye kuzamura umubare w’abaturage bafite mutuweli, mu rwego rwo gukemura ikibazo cy’abazaga kwivuza batayifite kuko biri mu mihigo Uturere tuba twahigiye imbere y’Umukuru w’Igihugu.

Yagize ati: “Ku bijyanye n’abambuye ibitaro, harimo kudakorana neza n’Inzego tugiye kubisuzuma kandi bizakemuka.”

Kayitesi avuga ko hari inzira abaturage badafite ubushobozi banyuramo kugira ngo bafashwe, igihombo cyavuzwe kizaganirwaho gishakirwe igisubizo.

Naho ku birebana n’abakozi bagengwa n’amasezerano, avuga ko bagiye kureba icyo amategeko ateganya maze bayashyire mu bikorwa.

Ibitaro bya Kabgayi bivuga ko muri miliyoni 54 binjiza ku mwaka, muri yo abagengwa n’amasezerano bahembwa miliyoni 44, abandi bake basigaye bagahembwa na Leta.

Gusa Guverineri yagiriye inama aba bakozi ko bagomba kuzamura ibipimo by’ubuzima bitaye cyane mu guha ababagana serivisi nziza bishimira.

title: ADEPR: Bishop Sibomana waciye amarenga ko ash...
content:
Nyuma y’imyaka 75 mu itorero ADEPR habaye impinduka ziri kuvugisha benshi mu bakristo baryo bamwe bakabyita ubuhenebere mu mwuka abandi bakavuga ko ari iterambere ndetse bigashimangirwa na Bishop Tom Rwagasana watangaje ko batakomeza guhora mu bya cyera (bishaje).

Kuri uyu wa 22 Kanama 2016 Inyarwanda.com ni yo yatangaje bwa mbere inkuru y’uko abayobozi bakuru ba ADEPR (umuvugizi mukuru n’umwungirije) bizamuye mu ntera bakava ku rwego rwa Reverend bakajya ku rwego rwa Musenyeri (Bishop), bikemezwa n’abapasiteri bari mu nama bahuriyemo muri uku kwezi kwa Kanama 2016 gusa imyanzuro yayo ikaba yaragizwe ibanga, bikaba byatangajwe nyuma yaho Inyarwanda yandikiye inkuru.

Nyuma yo kugirwa ba Musenyeri, itangazamakuru ribabajije impamvu bakoze izo mpinduka nyuma y’imyaka 75 iri torero rimaze ndetse niba abakristo batazabifata ukundi bakabyijujutira, Bishop Tom Rwagasana umuvugizi wungirije wa ADEPR yavuze ko bagomba kujyana n’iterambere ndetse ngo abababwirije ubutumwa nabo bakaba bakoresha ayo mazina ya Bishop bityo nabo kuyakoresha akaba yumva nta we byari bikwiye gutera ikibazo.

Mu bisubizo yatanze, yahishuraga ko abakristo ba ADEPR bagomba kwitegura izindi mpinduka mu bintu bitandukanye ndetse zimwe batangiye kuzibona. Urugero ni aho amakorali ya ADEPR yemerewe kujya ajya kuvuga ubutumwa mu yandi matorero dore ko mbere byafatagwa nko kwifatanya n'abanyamahanga bityo korali ibikoze ikabihanirwa. Magingo aya ibyari imiziro n'imipaka byamaze kuvanwaho bishimishia benshi.

Bishop Sibomana Jean usabirwa kuba Papa kimwe nk'umushumba wa Kiliziya Gaturika ku isi

Bishop Sibomana Jean abajijwe impamvu biyimitse ntibabibwire abakristo ndetse n’impamvu babikoze nyuma y’imyaka 75, yatangaje ko uretse kuba bagizwe ba Bishop, no kuba Apotre (Apotre) ngo ari ibintu bishoboka cyane. Ku bijyanye n’abakristo bari batangiye kubika itorero (bati RIP ADEPR) n’abandi batabyakiriye neza, yababwiye ko nta gikuba cyacitse anababwira ko bazabimenyeshwa n’abapasiteri babo.

Bishop Sibomana ashobora kuba PAPA?

Nubwo bigenda bivugwa na bamwe mu bakristo b’iri torero bakavuga ko bajyaga baterwa ipfunwe no kuba nta Bishop na Apotre bagira mu itorero ryabo mu gihe hari amatorero mato usanga abafite, hari bamwe bataripfanye basabira Bishop Sibomana kugirwa Papa, ubundi abamwungirije bagahabwa izindi ‘Title’ ziri munsi y'iye. Hari abamwifuriza kuba Papa kubera nubundi kuba yabaye Bishop ari inyota y'icyubahiro yari afite.

Umusomyi wa Inyarwanda.com yasabye ko Sibomana yazaba Nyirubutungane kubera gushaka ikuzo n'ibindi. Undi mukristo wa ADEPR yatangaje ko ababajwe no kuba itorero barirekeye abatarakebwe, ibyo bigakorwa abashumba barebera. Kuri we yavuze ko Depite Edouard Bamporiki ariwe ngo wajyaga ababwiza ukuri. Benshi basabye abasenga gusengera ADEPR kuko ngo urugamba rugeze aho rukomeye.

Inkoramutima ya ADEPR yatambukije ubutumwa bushimagiza Bishop Sibomana Jean, asaba abamuzamuye mu ntera ko bazongera bakicara bakamugira Papa. Mu butumwa yanyujije ku rubuga Isange.com, yavuze ko kuri we asanga ADEPR yubakitse nka Kiliziya Gatulika bityo umuyobozi wayo akaba akwiye kugirwa Papa. Mu ibaruwa ye, yagize ati:

"Nyuma yo gusoma inkuru ivuga ko Sibomana, umuyobozi wa ADEPR, yatangarije ikinyamakuru www.isange.com; ko uretse no kuba ba Bishop, ko bashobora no kuzaba ba Apotre; njye ndasanga, Sibomana baba bamugabanyirije amagarade ahubwo bashyize mu gaciro, akwiye kugirwa Papa.

Dore impamvu ntanze iki gitekerezo (proposition):

Iyo urebye umuvuduko itorero rya ADEPR rifite, aho kuva mu gihe kitari kirekire cyane ryamaze kugira abayoboke benshi, ibyo bikajyana, n’umubare w’abayobozi benshi kandi bafite inshingano zitandukanye, usanga kuba iryo torero ryagira umu Papa, byaba bifite ishingiro.

Iyo urebye ingazi z’ubuyobozi bwo muri ADEPR, usanga bushaka kubakika nk’ubw’i Roma, aho amabwiriza yose aturuka iyo ibukuru; ugasanga ubwigenge bukenewe kurutaho mu nzego zo hasi, kandi hakenewe icyitwa kumanura ibikorwa muri izo nzego bakazongerera ububasha, aribyo bita Decentralisation, mu rurimi rwa wa mugabo Moliere; ni indi mpamvu mbona hajyaho Umu Papa.

Iyo urebye itorero ADEPR uko ryubatse, guhera ku nzego zo hasi kugera hejuru, usanga ryubatse mu buryo bw’ingazi ( Hierarchie), guhera ku witwa Mwalimu , ukazamuka ukagera kuri Assistant Pasteri uyubora umudugudu, ugakomeza ukagera kuri Pasteri uyobora Paruwasi, ukigira hejuru ukagera kuri Pasteri w’ururembo, ( Ntangiye kunanirwa) , ukazamuka ukagera kuw’Umurenge n’intara,( Ahuuu!), ukaruhukira kuri Representant, usanga rwose izo nzego izina ry’ubu Pasteri zirwaniraho, zari zikwiye gushakirwa andi mazina, noneho hejuru yayo hakaba Papa.

Njyewe Uwagiriweneza, maze kubona uburambe Nyakubahwa Sibomana afite mu kazi, ngakurikiza na kiriya gisubizo yatanze avuga ko uretse no kuba ba Bishop, bshobora no kuba Aba Apotres; mu bubasha n’uburenganzira mpabwa no kugira uburenganzira ku bitekerezo( droit d’opinion), ngatanga igitekerezo cyubaka sosiyete; NAMAMARIJE SIBOMANA KUBA PAPA WA ADEPR. Ubwo iby’Izina wenda bamwita Papa Sibomana wa Mbere, kuko nyine ari ubwa mbere byaba bibaye.

Nyabuna nimunshyigikire!, Ni ubakunda cyane, wari ugarutse

Ku bijyanye n’icyifuzo cy’uyu mukristo wa ADEPR ushobora no kuba ari umwe mu bayobozi bakomeye muri iri torero wanditse iyi nyandiko, nubwo bigoye ko Bishop Sibomana yagira igisubizo amuha ako kanya, usesenguye neza usanga nyuma yo kuba Bishop, hazakurikiraho n’andi ma Title atari amenyerewe muri ADEPR nkuko Bishop Sibomana yabiciyemo amarenga akavuga ko kuba Apotre bishoboka.

Umwe mu basesenguzi, waganiriye na Inyarwanda, yavuze ko kuba Sibomana na Tom bizamuye mu ntera bakaba ba Bishop, ari iturufu yo kugundira ubuyobozi bwa ADEPR dore ko bari basigaje amezi macye. Ibi ariko babiteye utwatsi bavuga ko ataribyo bagamije, gusa wakurikiza ijambo bavuze ry’uko batazahora mu bya cyera, ugsanga byose bishoboka na cyane ko ari agatsiko kabo kabitegura.

title: Nyuma yo gutakarizwa icyizere n'intumwa za ru...
content:
Intumwa za rubanda zo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zamaze gutakariza icyizere Perezida Donald Trump. Ibi byabaye kuri uyu wa Gatatu nyuma yo kumuhamya ibyaha bibiri birimo: gukoresha nabi ububasha ahabwa ndetse no kubangamira imirimo y'iyi nteko y'intumwa za rubanda.

Mu mpera z'ukwezi kwa Nzeli ni bwo urugendo rwo kweguza Perezida Trump ku mirimo ye rwatangiye. Kuri uyu wa Gatatu uyu mu perezida yiyongereye mu mateka y'Amerika kubera ko abaye uwa gatatu utakarijwe icyizere n'Abadepite ku mirimo y'umukuru w'iki gihugu.

Nyuma y'uko uru rugendo rutangiye rwo kumweguza rwagiye rugira ibice. Mu bice by'ingenzi byaranze uru rugendo harimo nko kwiga ku birego Donald Trump aregwa, iperereza ryari rikuriwe n'akanama k'intumwa za rubanda, kumva abatangabuhamya ndetse n'ibindi. Icyo twakwibutsa abantu ni uko ibi byose byaberaga mu Nteko Nshingamategeko.

Ubusanzwe iyi ngingo y'iyeguzwa rya Perezida si we rireba gusa kuko rireba n'abandi bayobozi bakuru. Kuri iyi nshuro iyi ngingo irareba Perezida Donald Trump nyuma yo gushinjwa gukoresha nabi ububasha ahabwa ndetse no kubangamira imirimo y'Inteko Nshingamategeko.

Iyo bibaye ngombwa ko umuyobozi akoresheje ububasha bwe nabi, Inteko Nshingamategeko, nyuma yo kwiga ku bibazo nyir'ubwite aregwa, umutwe w'intumwa za rubanda zitora amatora agamije kureba ikigero cy'icyizere izi ntumwa zigirira uyu muyobozi.

Iyo umubare munini ugaragaje gutakatiza icyizere uwo muyobozi, babimenyesha abasenateri, nyuma y'isomwa ry'urubanza imbere y'abasenateri na bo bagira amatora noneho yemeza ko uwo muyobozi yegura cyangwa ategura ku mirimo ye.

Abandi baperezida bagize ibi bihe byo gushaka kweguzwa y'Inteko Nshingamategeko ni Andrew Johnson ndetse na Bill Clinton. Nyuma y'uko intumwa za rubanda zitoye ku ngingo y'uko Trump yakoresheje nabi ububasha bwiganze ahabwa, abemeje iyi ngingo bari 230 ku 197 bayirwanyije.

Ingingo ya kabiri yemeza ko Trump yabangamiye imikorere y'inteko muri iki gikorwa bo bari 229 ku 198. Abakurikirana bya hafi politiki bemeza ko ibi bigaragaza ko iyi nteko idashyize hamwe ahubwo ko abayirimo baharanira inyungu z'amashyaka yabo dore ko nta mu Repuburikani watoye agaragaza ko atakarije icyizere Trump ahubwo byakozwe n'abademokarate badahuje ishyaka.

Icyo twakwibutsa abantu ni uko umutwe w'intumwa za rubanda ufite umubare munini w'abademokarate kurusha abarepuburikani ari na bo Perezida Trump abarizwamo. Ku rundi ruhande, umutwe w'abasenateri na wo abenshi ni abarepeburikani.

Ubu igikurikiraho ni uko abasenateri ari bo bazemeza ko Trump yeguzwa cyangwa ateguzwa ku mirimo ye mu kwezi gutaha. Kweguza Trump, birahabwa amahirwe macye kuko ubwiganze bw'abarepuburikani muri uyu mutwe utazashyigikira iki gikorwa.

Hari ababona iki gikorwa nk'agakino ka politiki abo mu ishyaka ry'abademokarate bateguye ko guharabika isura ya Perezida Trump bazaba bahanganye mu matora y'umukuru w'iki gihugu azaba mu mwaka utaha. Abandi ntibahwema kwerekana ko koko Trump akwiye kwegura.

Ese aka gakino ka politiki karerekeza he?

Nancy Pelosi ukuriye umutwe w'intumwa za rubanda we yerekanye ko yishimiye intambwe ya mbere yo gutakariza icyizere Trump. Nyamara yerekanye impungenge avuga ko batashyiraho akanama gakuriye iyeguzwa ry'uyu muperezida bataramenya icyo bagenzi babo bo mu mutwe w'abasenateri bavuga kuri iyo ngingo.

Senateri Mitch McConnell uhagarariye umutwe w'abasenateri yatangaje ko kuri uyu wa Kane ku isaha ya saa munani n'igice ku isaha mpuzamahanga ko ari bwo aza kugira icyo atangaza kuri iyi ngingo yo kweguza Perezida Donald Trump.

title: Abazegukana irushanwa ‘The Next Popstar’ bazamenyekana mu kwezi gutaha
content:
Abahanzi bose uko ari batandatu basigaye muri iryo rusanwa batangiye imyiteguro, ku Cyumweru tariki 21 Gashyantare 2021, ni bwo bongeye kwiyereka Abanyarwanda kugira ngo batangire kubatora.

Abo bahanzi ni Cyiza Jackson, Gisa Cy’Inganzo, Yannik Gashiramanga, Ish Kevin, Hirwa Irakoze Honorine na Jasmine Kibatega.

Umuyobozi mukuru wa Network Showbiz (NSB), imwe muri Kompanyi zateguye iryo rushanwa, Hemdee David, yihanganishije abo bahanzi ku mpinduka zatewe na Covid-19, abasaba gukomeza imyiteguro.

Yagize ati “Mfashe uyu mwanya ngo mbwire abari mu irushanwa ko turi kumwe. Ndabizi ko bitewe na Covid-19 tutashoboye gukora ibikorwa byose uko byari biteganyijwe. Ntimucike intege, mukomeze muririmbe, mwitegure bihagije kuko igikorwa cyo gusoza irushanwa kiri hafi”.

Yongeyeho ko “abazatsinda bazajya muri Amerika bakorane n’abantu bakomeye mu muziki”.

Tariki 14 Werurwe 2021 ni bwo hateganjijwe igitaramo ‘Live performance’ cyo gutoranyamo abahanzi babiri ba mbere bazegukana ibihembo, ni igitaramo kizaca ‘live’ kuri KC2.

Biteganyijwe ko umuhanzi wa mbere azegukana ibihembo bifite agaciro ka milioni 50 z’Amafaranga y’u Rwanda (Rwf50M) mu gihe uwa kabiri we Sosiyete ya SM1 MUSIC GROUP/ SONY MUSIC GROUP izamufasha kumenyekanisha ibihangano bye ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Abo bahanzi bombi kandi bazakorera urugendo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika aho bazishyurirwa ibyangombwa byose, birimo amafaranga y’urugendo, aho kuba n’ibizabatunga mu gihe cyose bazahamarayo.

The Next Pop Star ni irushanwa rigamije kuzamura abahanzi nyarwanda bakagera ku rwego mpuzamahanga, ryateguwe na sosiyete mpuzamahanga zinyuranye zihagarariwe mu Rwanda na kompanyi itegura ibitaramo yitwa More Events.

title: U Bwongereza: Ifi yakorewe umwambaro uyifasha koga
content:
Iyo fi yo mu Bwongereza ngo yarwaye indwara idakira yitwa ‘Bladder disorder’ igira ingaruka ku bushobozi bwayo bwo kureremba mu mazi (buoyancy), bigatuma ahubwo irohama.

Ubusanzwe iyo ndwara ya ‘bladder disorder’ hari ubwo yikiza nyuma y’iminsi mike, cyane iyo yari yatewe n’ibibazo bijyanye n’inzira y’igogora yayo idakora neza, ariko kuri iyo fi yo mu Bwongereza, iyo ndwara ntiyakiraga.

Nyuma yo kubona ko iyo fi idakira kandi kubera kudashobora koga, byatumaga ihora iryamye ku ndiba y’icyo yororerwagamo.

Umuryango wari uyoroye washatse uko wayifasha gusohoka muri icyo kibazo kuko babonaga ibabara, bayijyana ahantu hagenewe gushyirwa inyamaswa zifite ibibazo bidakira, kugira ngo ziharangirize ubuzima mu mutekano.

Uwitwa Stacey O’Shea, uyobora aho hakirirwa izo nyamaswa ‘Garden Sanctuary’, yahise atekereza uko yakorera iyo fi umwambaro wajya utuma ishobora koga ntirohame (special lifejacket).

Uwo mwamboro ubu ufasha iyo fi kureremba mu mazi, yawukoze yifashishije utuntu twa pulasitiki tumeze nk’imiheha tworoshye, nyuma yongeyeho akandi gakoresho gatuma ishobora kujya mu mazi hasi igihe ibishatse.

title: Danny Runyange wahoze mu biyobyabwenge agiye...
content:
Kuri uyu wa gatanu tariki 25 Ukuboza 2015, umuhanzi Danny Runyange yateguye igitaramo cyo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana kizabera Kabarore mu karere ka Gatsibo aho azaba ari kumwe n’abahanzi batandukanye barimo Brian Blessed n’abandi.

Nk’uko Danny Runyange yabitangarije Inyarwanda.com icyo gitaramo cye kizabera Kabarore mu itorero Calvary ahazwi nko kwa Kazungu. Yakomeje adutangariza ko yagiteguye mu rwego rwo kwifatanya n’abakristo baho mu kwizihiza kuvuka kwa Yesu Kristo no gushimira Imana imirimo y’amaboko yayo no kuba bashoje umwaka amahoro.

Brian Blessed ni umwe mu bahanzi batumiwe muri iki gitaramo

Iki gitaramo cye cyo kuri Noheli agiteguye nyuma y’ibitaramo bibiri birimo icyo yakoreye mu karere ka Kayonza,n’ikindi yakoreye i Kanombe mu mujyi wa Kigali kuwa 22/11/2015. Muri iki gitaramo azabana na Brian Blessed, Birashoboka, Tony Nkuranga, Gato Steven, Karangwa Fred n’abandi. Kwinjira muri icyo gitaramo ni 1000Frw na 500Frw ku bana bato.

Danny Runyange mu buhamya bwe avuga ko mbere atari yakizwa yahoze mu biyobyabwenge ariko Imana ikaza kumugirira ubuntu ikamuha agakiza. Ubuhanzi yabutangiriye mu karere ka Kayonza nyuma aza kwimukira i Kigali ari naho atuye magingo aya.

Nyuma yo kuva mu biyobyabwenge Danny Runyange wakiriye agakiza mu mwaka wa 1997, yiyemeje gufasha abandi abinyujije mu ndirimbo z’Imana. Kuva icyo gihe yatangiye kujya yandika indirimbo zikubiyemo ubutumwa busaba urubyiruko gutegura ubuzima bwiza bw’ejo hazaza.

Nakoresheje ibiyobyabwenge by’amoko yose kandi byinshi, Imana iza kubinkuramo muri 97, ari nabwo nafashe izina rya gatatu nitwa 97, kuva icyo gihe rero nibwo numvise ko nanjye hari icyo ngomba gukora kugira ngo mfashe bagenzi banjye bakibaswe n’ibiyobyabwenge”.Danny Runyange.

Danny Runyange wahoze mu biyobyabwenge

Danny Runyange kuri ubu umaze kugeza indirimbo 20 harimo n’iyo yise 97 igaragaza uko yakijijwe ndetse n’indi nshya ikunzwe cyane yitwa “Mana dukize uburetwa”, avuga ko nyuma y’igitaramo azakorera Kabarore, ateganya gukora ibindi bitandukanye hirya no hino mu gihugu ndetse no mu mujyi wa Kigali kuko ari wo ugaragaramo abakoresha ibiyobyabwenge cyane.

title: Tekereza ahantu uzira kubwiriza ubutumwa bw' IMANA! Umuyobozi wa College Adventiste de Gitwe yatawe muri yombi
content:
Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Ubugenzacyaha (RIB) rwatangaje ko rwafashe umuyobozi w’ishuri College Adventiste de Gitwe, Nshimiyimana Gilbert, ukekwaho kugira uruhare mu guhatira abana kuyoboka idini.

Ku rubuga rwa Twitter, RIB yavuze ko ibyo uyu muyobozi w’ishuri akekwaho binyuranyije n’uburenganzira bw’umwana, ihame ry’uburezi ndetse n’amahame agenga amadini.

Urwego rw’igihugu rw’ubugenzacyaha kandi rwatangaje ko ruboneyeho kwibutsa ibigo by’amashuri n’Abanyarwanda muri rusange ko abana bafite ubwisanzure mu mitekerereze, mu kugaragaza ibitekerezo byabo, kugira umutimanama no guhitamo idini.

RIB ikaba yasabye abayobozi b’amashuri kubahiriza ubwo burenganzira.

Umuvugizi wa RIB Marie Michelle Umuhoza, yabwiye Kigali Toda ko nta makuru menshi batangaza, na cyane ko ubu hari gukorwa iperereza ku byaha uyu muyobozi ashinjwa.

Mbere yuko uyu muyobozi afungwa, Minisitiri w’Uburezi Dr. Eugene Mutimura kuwa kabiri tariki ya 05 Ugushyingo 2019, yari yatangaje ko ibyo guhatira abana kuyoboka idini bitemewe, ko ndetse ari ukubafatirana, ndetse asaba inzego bireba zirimo na RIB kubikurikirana.

Dr. Mutimura yanditse kuri Twitter ati “Ibi ni uburyo bwo gufatirana abanyeshuri bakiri bato, bibambura uburenganzira bwo kwihitiramo.Turasaba inzego zibishinzwe za Leta nka RIB gukurikirana abayobozi nk’aba n’abandi bose bakora muri ubwo buryo kugira ngo bicike mu mashuri”.

Minisitiri Mutimuka kandi yanenze uburyo umuyobozi w’ishuri rya College Adventiste de Gitwe yasobanuye uburyo abanyeshuri babona ireme ry’uburezi.

Ati “Ntabwo twemeranya n’umuyobozi wa College Adventiste de Gitwe ku bisobanuro atanga ku ireme ry’uburezi. urugero, ubumenyi n’ubushobozi umunyeshuri abona bishingira ku bizamini atsinda buri gihembwe, ku mwaka n’igihe ava mu cyiciro ajya mu kindi”.Ni nyuma y’ikiganiro mu mashusho ubuyobozi bw’ishuri n’abanyeshuri bo muri College Adventiste de Gitwe bagiranye na ’Afrimax TV’, cyanagaragayemo umuhango wo kubatiza abanyeshuri bemeye kuyoboka idini y’Abadivantisiti b’umunsi wa karindwi.

title: Miss Rwanda 2019: Mwiseneza Josiane waturutse...
content:
Wari umunsi wuzuyemo akanyamuneza ku bitabiriye Miss Rwanda I Rubavu nyamara benshi batunguwe na Josiane wagaragaraga nk’udasirimutse cyane. Kuba hari benshi bamurushaga ubusirimu ntibyabujije Josiane guhigika abandi aboneka muri 6 bazahagararira Uburengerazuba muri Miss Rwanda.

Nyuma yo gupimwa ibiro n’uburebure ndetse no kuvuga imyirondoro, abakobwa 13 muri 17 bari bitabiriye nibo babashije kwemererwa guhatana. Aba bakobwa buri wese yaje yifitiye icyizere ndetse bagerageje gusa neza no kwambara neza.

13 bose baciye imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka babazwa ibibazo bitandukanye mu Kinyarwanda no mu rundi rurimi umukobwa yifuzaga kubazwamo rw’amahanga hagati y’icyongereza n’igifaransa. Abakemurampaka bashimiye abitabiriye ndetse basobanura ibigenderwaho ari byo ubwiza ubumenyi n’uburyo abahatana berekana ubwo bumenyi.

Ubwiza no kwiyerekana byahawe amanota 30, ubumenyi buhabwa 40 naho uburyo umukobwa yisobanura cyangwa agaragaza bwa bumenyi bihabwa nabyo 30, amanita yose akaba 100. Josiane wari wavuye iwabo n’amaguru ndetse yanakomeretse ku ino yagize amahirwe yo guhamagarwa bwa nyuma muri 6 bazahagararira intara y’uburengerazuba, abigeraho ahigitse bagenzi be bagera kuri 7.

Dore amazina y'abazahagararira Uburengerazuba muri Miss Rwanda 2019:

Josiane yahamagawe bwa nyuma benshi baratungurwa, gusa abanyamakuru bose bahise bavuza induru y'ibyishimo bagiriye uyu mukobwa

">Kanda hano urebe ikiganiro na buri mukobwa mu bazahagararira intara y'Uburengerazuba

">Reba abakobwa bitabiriye amajonjora ya Rubavu

i Rubavu hiyamamaje umukobwa ukomoka kwa Nyiransibura

title: Rayon Sports yazanye Rutahizamu w’Umunya-Guinée, w’imyaka 22 wakinaga mugihugu cy’Ubufaransa, aremeza ko buri mukino azajya atsinda igitego
content:
Rutahizamu w’Umunya-Guinée, Mamady Barry yatangiye igeragezwa muri Rayon Sports, aho naramuka yemeje abatoza b’iyi kipe nta kabuza azahita ahabwa amasezerano, dore ko ngo anafite inyota yo gukinira iyi kipe.

Mamady Barry w’imyaka 22 wakinaga mu Bufaransa ni rutahizamu ukina ku mpande asatira akoresheje ukuguru kw’imoso, yavutse tariki 22 Mutarama 1997, akaba yarageze mu Rwanda ku wa Gatatu tariki 04 Ukuboza 2019, aho yatangiye imyitozo kuri uyu wa Kane mu Nzove.

Aganira n’urubuga rwa interineti rwa Rayon Sports, Mamady yavuze ko yishimiye kuza kugerageza amahirwe muri iyi kipe yumvise ko ifite amateka akomeye.

Mamady Barry yagize ati “Numvise izina rya Rayon Sports, narimenye ndibwiwe n’ushinzwe kunshakira isoko. Yambwiye ko ari ikipe nkuru kandi ikomeye ifite n’imishinga myiza y’ahazaza niyo mpamvu nafashe umwanzuro wo kuza aha. Nabonye ari ikipe nziza. Nakoze imyitozo iri ku rwego rwo hejuru. Mfite inzozi zo gukina muri iyi kipe y’amateka mu Rwanda. Nifuza kongera ubunararibonye bwanjye n’impano kubyo iyi kipe isanganywe.”

Mu mwaka wa 2017, Mamady Barry wari ufite imyaka 20, yari mu bakinnyi ngenderwaho b’ikipe y’igihugu ya Guinée-Conakry yabaye iya gatatu mu gikombe cya Afurika cy’abatarengeje imyaka 20 cyegukanywe na Zambia, ni mu gihe kandi yari kandi mu ikipe ya Guinée yakinnye igikombe cy’Isi cy’abatarengeje imyaka 20 cyabereye muri Korea y’Epfo, mu itsinda rimwe na Argentine, u Bwongereza na Korea y’Epfo yari yakiriye irushanwa.

Nyuma y’iki gikombe cy’Isi Mamady Barry yagiye mu Bufaransa, aho yakoze igeragezwa mu makipe atandukanye arimo; FC Nantes yo mu cyiciro cya mbere na FC Sochaux yo mu cyiciro cya kabiri ariko ntiyahirwa asubira iwabo aho yakinnye mu makipe atandukanye arimo Soumba FC, Renaissance Football Club na Hafia FC.

Aya makipe yayavuyemo asubira mu Bufaransa kongera kugerageza amahirwe biranamuhira akinira ES Boulazac Isle Manoire FC yo mu cyiciro cya kane mu Bufaransa.

Naramuka ashimwe n’abatoza ba Rayon Sports, aziyongera ku munya-Côte d’Ivoire Drissa Dagnogo uherutse gusinyira iyi kipe mu minsi ishize, ndetse na Myugariro w’umunyarwanda, Kayumba Soter wa AFC Leopards yo muri Kenya n’ubwo ibye bitarasobanuka neza.

title: Canada- Polisi yitabajwe mu gitaramo Anne Kan...
content:
Umunyarwenya Anne Kansiime yakiranywe urugwiro n’abakunzi be baba mu gihugu cya Canada mu gitaramo yatumiwemo n’abanyarwanda. Iki gitaramo cyahuruje imbaga abantu bamwe babura aho bicara basubizwayo biteza akavuyo cyane hitabazwa Polisi.

Umunyarwandakazi watumiye Anne Kansiime, Olive Mutoni yabwiye inyarwanda.com ko igitaramo cyabo cyagenze neza cyane kikitabirwa n’abasaga 400 ariko abantu benshi bakaba barasubiyeyo kubera kubura aho bicara bataha bijujuta kubera kubura amahirwe yo gutaramana na Kansiime.

Kubera akavuyo k'abantu bari babuze imyanya bicaramo, Olive Mutoni yadutangarije ko byabaye ngombwa hakitabazwa inzego zishinzwe umutekano kugirango zibasubizeyo. Kansiime yamaze isaha asetsa abagize amahirwe yo kwitabira igitaramo cye arongera afata indi saha yifotozanya n’abakunzi be.

Olive Mutoni umunyarwandakazi watumiye Anne Kansiime

Kansiime yasekeje abantu bicwa n'ibitwenge

Icyo gitaramo cyatumiwemo Umugandekazi Anne Kansiime wahawe akazina k’umwamikazi wa Afrika mu gutera urwenya(African Queen of Comedy), cyabaye kuwa gatandatu tariki 12 Nzeri 2015 mu mujyi wa Ottawa ariko byageze kuwa kane tariki 10 Nzeri amatike yo kwinjira ngo yashize.

Ibi byahamirije abatumiye Anna Kansiime ko akunzwe cyane ndetse bibasigira isomo ryo kuzashaka ahantu hanini mu gitaramo cy’ubutaha bazongera kumutumiramo umwaka utaha wa 2016.

Anne Kansiime yahuruje imbaga muri Amerika mu gihugu cya Canada

Olive Mutoni avuga ko yatunguwe cyane no kubona Televiziyo zikomeye muri Canada zihuruzwa n’umunyarwenya Kansiime mu gihe avuga ko atigeze azitumira kuko bitari kumworohera kuzigeraho.

Kwinjira muri iki gitaramo cya Anne Kansiime byari amadorali 40 y’Amerika (29.000Frw) mu myanya isanzwe, amadorali 65 (47.000Frw) VIP naho abinjiye ari babiri (couple) akaba ari amadorali 120(87.000 Frw).

title: SALAX AWARDS7: Ab’inkwakuzi batangiye kwaniki...
content:
Mu minsi ishize ni bwo hamenyekanye abahanzi batanu muri buri cyiciro bahatanira ibihembo bya Salax Awards iri kuba ku nshuro yayo ya karindwi mu gihe cy’imyaka icumi ibi bihembo bimaze bitangirwa ku butaka bw’u Rwanda. Kuri ubu amatora ku bahanzi bahatanira ibihembo yamaze gutangira.

Nyuma y’amasaha 48 aya matora atangiye ab’inkwakuzi batangiye kwanikira abandi mu majwi mu gihe ariko nanone hari abahanzi utamenya neza niba abakunzi babo baramenye ko amatora yatangiye. Aha hari bamwe mu bahanzi usanga badafite n’ijwi na rimwe ariko nanone ku rundi ruhande usanga abahanzi bamwe bamaze kwereka igihandure abo bahanganye mu majwi.

Abahanzi batanu mu byiciro icyenda bisobanura ko ari nimero 45 zamaze gutangwa. Kimwe mu byatangajwe n'abategura Salax Awards ni uko amatora yo muri iki cyiciro ari kuba hifashishijwe SMS gusa, abahanzi bari gutorwa wandika umubare w’umuhanzi ushyigikiye hanyuma ukohereza kuri 7333 ugahesha amahirwe umuhanzi ushyigikiye ngo abe yakwegukana igihembo muri buri cyiciro.

Tubibutse ko kugeza ubu gutora biri gukorwa hifashishijwe SMS gusa nk'uko Ahmed Pacifique umuyobozi wa AHUPA itegura Salax Awards yabitangarije Inyarwanda.com. Ibi bisobanuye ko gutora ku mbuga nkoranyambaga byamaze gukurwaho hakazabarwa amajwi ya SMS gusa. Amajwi ya SMS azateranywa n'abagize akanama nkemurampaka bityo abegukana ibikombe muri buri cyiciro Uko umuntu atoye muri SALAX Awards7 ijwi rye rihita ryiyongera ku ya majwi bikagaragarira ku rubuga rw’ibi bihembo rwa salax.rw.

Abahanzi banyuranye barimo Queen Cha, The Same, Just Family, Mc Tino na Ama G The Black ni bamwe mu bafite amajwi menshi ariko nanone ugasanga hari abataragira ijwi na rimwe barimo; Peace Jolis, Deo Munyakazi ,Jules Sentore ,Sophia Nzayisenga, Yemba Voice na Andy Bumuntu.

title: Abahanzi b’iki gihe dusigaye turirimba indiri...
content:
Mani Martin witegura guhurira mu gitaramo n’abahanzi bo hambere aratangaza ko afite inyota yo kubigiraho byinshi harimo kubasha gukora indirimbo zidasaza kuko we asanga abahanzi b’iki gihe bakora indirimbo , uburyohe bwazo bukarangirana n’igihe gito cyane kitageze no ku mezi abiri.

Ku itariki 19 Kamena 2015 kuri Serena Hotel hazabera igitaramo kizahuza abahanzi Byumvuhore, Makanyaga,Ben Kipeti ndetse na Mani Martin mu rwego rwo kwibuka kun nshuro ya 33 Padiri Fraipont Ndagijimana washinze ikigo cya Gatagara cyita ku bafite ubumuga ari nacyo umuhanzi Byumvuhore yakuriyemo.

Mu kiganiro kirekire yagiranye na inyarwanda.com yadusobanuriye uko yiteguye iki gitaramo ndetse n’icyo yiteze kwigira ku bahanzi bamuboneye izuba muri muzika cyane cyane Byumvuhore Jean Baptiste.

“Mufata icya mbere nk’umuntu ukomeye cyane kandi w’icyitegererezo ,ntanubwo turahura na rimwe ndumva ari n’ubwambere tuzaba tugiye guhura ariko ni umwe mu bantu nakuze numva indirimbo ze kandi zandikanye ubuhanga bukomeye cyane zifite n’ibintu byinshi zibutsa abantu. Nishimiye cyane kuba baratekereje ko twakorana nk’umwe mu bahanzi bakiri batoya cyangwa se b’iki gihe , ndabyishimiye cyane , cyane ni kimwe mu bintu bya mbere nzishimira gukorana igitaramo na Byumvuhore na bariya bandi.”

Umuhanzi Byumvuhore Jean Baptiste waririmbye indirimbo zikundwa na benshi, mu ngeiz zose

Icyo azungukira mu gukorana igitaramo n’abahanzi baririmbye indirimbo zidasaza

Twabajije kandi Mani Martin icyo yaba ateganya kungukira mu gitaramo azahuriramo n’abahanzi baririmbye mu myaka myinshi ishize ariko indirimbo zabo ntizirambirane mu matwi y’abantu,Mani Martin asubiza muri aya magambo “Kugeza ubu sinamenya icyo bizanyungura kuko bitaraba, ntekereza yuko icyo nahita ntekereza aka kanya ni ukureba bo uko bakora bikaba byamfasha kumenya ni irihe banga bakoresheje ryatumye kugeza ku myaka 50 irenga baririmba abantu bakaba bakibumva kugeza uyu munsi.”

Ikibazo cy’indirimbo zitaramara kabiri asanga kitari mu Rwanda gusa

Martin ati “Mperuka kureba ikiganiro (interview) Rihanna wo muri Amerika yatangaga avuga ko rwose adakunda ibihangano bye na gatoya bitewe n’uko ngo abantu bashobora kubyumva amezi abiri, atatu nyuma yayo akumva abantu ntabwo bakibyumva. Icyo ni ikibazo rero kitari mu Rwanda gusa ahubwo kiri ku isi hose kuko twebwe abahanzi ba none ibihangano byacu bisa nkaho bishobora gushira, kuba expired mu ndirimi z’amahanga, ariko ugasanga bo, nka Byumvuhore , Kipeti cyangwa nka Makanyaga indirimbo zabo zarabayeho mu myaka myinshi cyane kugeza n’iki gihe kandi zitanacurangwa cyane no kuri radiyo . “

“Muri iyi si ya none abantu ahanini barashaka kumva indirimbo kuko bahora byumva kuri radiyo cyangwa bayibona kuri televiziyo, waza mu gitaramo abantu bakishima kuko bahora bayumva ariko bariya ntabwo indirimbo zabo zihora kuri radiyo cyangwa kuri televiziyo ariko iteka ryose duhorana inyota yo kuzumva no gushaka kubumva bacuranga . Icyo nicyo numva nzabigiraho no kuganira nabo nkumva ibanga bakoresheje byatumye kiriya kintu bakigeraho”

Iyo ubajije Mani Martin niba abona ko muzika yo mu Rwanda itakigira indirimbo ziramba ndetse kikaba ari n’ikintu abantu benshi bakunze kugenda binubira kuri muzika y’abubu, Mani Martin agusubiza muri aya mgambo” Njewe ndabibona ariko ntanubwo mbibona mu Rwanda gusa, mbibona ku isi ,uyu munsi imiziki ikorwa none ntabwo imiziki ba Rihanna bakora ariyo ba Tonny Braxton bakoraga cyangwa ba Houston.”

“ Ni kimwe rero no mu Rwanda ntabwo imiziki dukora ibasha kuramba nk’iya ba Makanyaga, Kayirebwa, ba Rugamba Sipiriyani cyangwa abandi batubanjirije , icyo kintu kirahari ntabwo nzi abandi uko babibona ariko kubwanjye ndakibona. Mbasha nko kubona indirimbo zigeze gukundwa mu myaka ya za 2011 zigakundwa kuburyo washobora kujya ahantu wagiye wenda nko mu gace(centre) wagiyemo iyo ariyo yose yo mu Rwanda, ugasanga buri rugo ruri kuzumva , mu modoka arizo zicurangwa, ariko uyu munsi ukaba udashobora kuba wakumva iyo ndirimbo atari uko radiyo zahagaritse kuyicuranga gusa ahubwo kuko na we ubwawe naho ari wowe waba ari wowe wayiririmbye, wumva na we udashaka kuyiririmba. Icyo navuga ni uko icyo kibazo gihari.”

Uburyohe bw’indirimbo busigaye burangira vuba cyane

“Uyu munsi ndamutse ngiye mu gitaramo , hari nk’indirimbo zakunzwe muri icyo nakubwiraga kuburyo nanjye ubwanjye ntashobora kwifuza kujya mu gitaramo ngo numve uwo muhanzi aziririmba kuko numva uburyohe bw’iyo ndirimbo bwarangiranye n’icyo gihe. Icyo kintu njyewe mpora nkibazaho ukuntu babashije kubirageraho kuko nka Byumvuhore afite indirimbo numvaga nkifite imyaka nk’itatu ariko nubu nkaba nkifuza kuyumva. Icyo kintu nicyo nshaka kwigira kuri bariya bahanzi.”

Uko yiteguye igitaramo n’icyo abakunzi ba muzika ye bamwitegaho

“Ewana ndi kwitegura kabisa,ndumva ngomba gukora imyitozo yanyuma kuwa kane .Icya mbere ni uko ngomba kubaha igitaramo kitazaba kirekire cyane kuko urumva tuzaba turi benshi ariko cyiza , narabyiteguye mu buryo buhagije nkuko nzanzwe nitegura ibindi bitaramo ikindi ni mugihe ndi no gusohora ibindi bihangano bishyashya ndumva bizaba bimeze neza.”

Iki gitaramo kizaba kuri uyu wa gatanu tariki 19 Kamena 2015 kibere kuri Serena Hotel guhera i saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba(18h00). Kwinjira bizaba ari ibihumbi icumi kuri buri muntu(10.000 Frw). Byumvuhore Jean Baptiste kuri ubu wamaze kugera mu Rwanda azafashwa n’abandi bahanzi b’abahanga mu gucuranga muzika y’umwimerere barimo Makaganyaga Abdul, Ben Kipeti ndetsena Mani Martin.

Ese na we uremeranya na Mani Martin ko indirimbo z'abubu zitaramba, zikarambirana mu matwi y'abakunzi ba muzika mu gihe gito?Niba ari yego hakorwa iki?

title: Padiri Hitayezu ukekwaho ibyaha bya Jenoside yatawe muri yombi
content:
Si ubwambere agejejwe imbere y’ubutabera kuko muri 2016 ubutabera bw’u Bufaransa bwari bwanze icyifuzo cy’Ubushinjacyaha bw’u Rwanda cyo kumwohereza mu gihugu mu Rwanda.

Itangazamakuru ryo mu gihugu cy’u Bufaransa rivuga ko Padiri Marcel Hitayezu acyekwaho ibyaha bya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bari muri Paruwasi ya Mubuga mu cyahoze ari Perefegitura ya Kibuye.

Padiri Hitayezu wari usanzwe aba mu gihugu cy’u Bufaransa, amakuru yemeza ko yatawe muri yombi ku wa Gatatu tariki 14 Mata 2021 aho atuye Montlieu-la-Garde.

Alain Ghautier, Umuyobozi w’umuryango CPCR wiyemeje gushakisha abakekwaho uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bihishe mu Burayi, yavuze ko iby’itabwa muri yombi rya padiri Hitayezu wayoboraga Paruwasi Gatolika ya Montlieu-la-Garde mu gihugu cy’u Bufaransa yatawe muri yombi nyuma yo kubazwa n’inzego z’Ubugenzacyaha mu Bufaransa ku byaha akekwaho muri 2019.

Urukiko rw’i Poitiers muri Nyakanga 2016, rwari rwafashe icyemezo ko Padiri Hitayezu yoherezwa mu Rwanda, gusa mu Kwakira 2016 urukiko rw’ubujurire rwanzura ko arekurwa.

Alain Ghautier avuga ko abagize CPCR bagiye mu Rwanda gushaka amakuru agaragaza uruhare rwa Padiri Hitayezu muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, maze basaba ko yatabwa muri yombi.

Abatangabuhamya bari kuri Paruwasi ya Mubuga mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, bavuga ko nyuma y’iraswa ry’indege ya Perezida Habyarimana, tariki ya 7 Mata 1994 kuri Paruwasi ya Mubuga hahungiye Abatutsi babarirwa hagati y’ibihumbi bine na bitanu bari baturiye iyo Paruwasi.

Bavuga ko ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki ya 15 Mata 1994, ndetse bukaba bwarahagarikiwe na Perefe Kayishema kuri ayo matariki.

Umwe mu bahahungiye witwa Pascal ndetse akahaburira umugore n’abana batanu avuga ko Padiri Hitayezu yari kumwe n’abicanyi kuko yari asanzwe ajya mu nama zabo, akavuga ko mu gihe Abatutsi bicwaga kuri Paruwasi yari ayoboye ntacyo yakoze ngo bashobore kurokoka.

Munyandinda wari wahahungiye avuga ko tariki 12 Mata 1994 bari bishwe n’inzara maze Padiri Hitayezu akabaha ibyo kurya bikeya ariko abasirikare bakamubuza ngo bizajya bihabwa abasirikare bari mu kazi.

title: Canada: Kaneza Sheja wamamaye mu ndirimbo 'Ka...
content:
"Kagame karambe, umugongo waguhetse uragahoraho. Intore izirusha intambwe, wabohoye u Rwanda, ubumwe n'ubwiyunge wabugize intego, natwe abana b'u Rwanda dufatanye urunana twubake urwatubyaye, jya mbere rudasumbwa abanyarwanda twese tukuri inyuma". Iyo ni indirimbo 'Kagame karambe' ya Kaneza Sheja wamaze kwambika umukunzi we impeta y'urukundo.

Kaneza Sheja Ruhindanisheja ni umuhanzi w'umuhanga ukora injyana Gakondo, muri iyi minsi akaba ari kubarizwa muri Canada. Yigishijwe umuziki n'inararibonye muri wo ari bo; Masamba Intore na Mighty Popo uyobora ishuri ry'umuziki rya Nyundo. Ntiyabaye nka bamwe bagera i mahanga bagahagarika umuziki, ahubwo yarawukomeje ndetse ubu yanongeyeho kuyobora ubukwe no kwita amazina y'inka.

Amaze kubona uko Kaneza Sheja yizihiye benshi mu bukwe bwa Alpha Rwirangira na Liliane Umuziranenge bwabaye tariki 22 Kanama 2020, Masamba Intore yamutangajeho amagambo akomeye. Mu butumwa yanyujije ku rukuta rwe rwa Instagram yaranditse ati "Bintera ishema ryinshi ariko bikampa n'icyizere ko u Rwanda rudateze kwongera kuzima kuko rwibarutse Intore zitari Intozo. Igihugu kitagira Umuco kiracika".

Hashize imyaka ibiri Kaneza Sheja abarizwa ku mugabane wa Amerika mu gihugu cya Canada. Uyu muhanzi avuga ko urukumbuzi afitiye u Rwanda n'abaturuye rumaze kuba rwinshi. Yatangaje ko akumbuye gutaramana n'abanyarwanda baba imbere mu gihugu. Imyaka ibiri amaze muri Canada yamubereye myiza cyane by'akarusho muri iyi minsi ari mu byishimo bikomeye yatewe no kubwirwa 'YEGO/YES' n'uyu mukunzi we Ingabire Diane wamurutiye abandi bakobwa bose bo ku Isi.

Kaneza Sheja mu munyenga w'urukundo n'umukunzi we Ingabire Diane

Ku wa Gatanu taliki ya 18/9/2020 ni bwo Kaneza Sheja yambitse impeta y'urukundo umukunzi we Diane mu gikorwa cyabereye mu mujyi wa Victoria Vancouver muri Canada. Mu kiganiro na INYARWANDA, Kaneza Sheja yadutangarije ko umukobwa yambitse impeta yamukundiye ingeso nziza arusha abandi. Yavuze ko yanyuzwe cyane no kubwirwa 'YEGO' n'uwo yihebeye kuko kugira inshuti nka Diane ari ibyishimo by'ikirenga kuri uyu muhanzi. Yagize ati:

Ni rwogere! Kaneza n'umukunzi we Ingabire barebana akana ko mu jisho

Iyo umusore asabye umukobwa ko bazabana akaramata, undi akakwemerera, ni ibintu by'umvikana ko bahita batangira gutegura ubukwe, igihe buzabera, aho buzabera n'ibindi. Abajijwe igihe bateganya kuzakorera ubukwe, Kaneza Sheja yagize ati "Ubukwe turacyabutegura tuzababwira nta kibazo".

Yakomeje avuga ko kuri ubu akomeje umuziki we akaba ari gutaramira abanyarwanda n'abanyamahanga mu birori bitandukanye, ati "Muzika yanjye imeze neza ndigutaramira Abanyarwanda n’Abanyamahanga mu bitaramo bitandukanye haba mu bukwe n'ibindi cyane muri Canada. Abafite ubukwe ndikubataramira cyane. Urugero nka mbere na nyuma y’ubukwe bwa Alpha Rwirangira".

Yakomeje ati "Nataramiye ubukwe butandukanye mu mijyi nka Hamilton, Ottawa, Toronto, Montreal na Quebec City. Bityo rero ndakomeje cyane, mbwira n’abafite ubukwe n’ibindi biriro ndahari cyane bambwire haba mu kubuyobora no kwita amazina y’inka ndetse dutaramane cyane. Nkaba mbafitiye indirimbo zitandukanye nziza za Gakondo ngiye kubashyirira hanze zaba iz'ubukwe ndetse n’iz’urukundo."

Udukingirizo two muri ubu bwoko bwa Life Guard tutujuje ubuziranenge ni two twakwirakwijwe

Nk'uko bitangazwa na BBC, Dr Carole uhagarariye uyu muryango yavuze ko mu dukingirizo twatumijwe nyuma yo gukwirakwizwa baje kumenya ko harimo amapaki abiri atujuje ubuziranenge.

Aya makosa yamaganiwe kure n’umuryango ushinzwe kugenzura ubuziranenge bw’imiti muri iki gihugu “Uganda's National Drug Authority (NDA)“ ku buryo mu mpera z’uku kwezi gushije umuyobozi w’uyu muryango Victoria Nambasa yabandikiye abasaba gutanga ubusobanuro bw’uko byagenze.

Yanditse agira ati”Tubahaye ibyumweru bibiri ngo mugaragaze uko byagenze ngo dukwirakwizwe”. Leta ya Uganda yasabye abafashe uti dukingirizo twangiritse kutugarura.

Ibi bibaye mu gihe Minisiteri y’ubuzima muri iki gihugu iherutse gutangaza ko hakenewe byibura udukingirizo miliyoni 800 kugira ngo barusheho gukumira icyorezo cya Sida, inda zitateganijwe n’izindi ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuza bitsina. Mu dukingirizo ibihumbi bine tutujuje ubuziranenge twavuzwe haruguru, nta makuru ahari agaragara yerekana ingano y’utwakoreshejwe muri two.

Nyuma yo kubona ko bafite umubare munini cyane w’abafatabuguzi bakoresha izindi serivisi zayo ariko batajya bakoresha interinet MTN Rwanda yafashe gahunda yo gusobanurira abnyarwanda bose guhera ku bakomeye kugeza ku boroheje imikoreshereze ya internet ndetse n’akamaro igirira umuntu uyikoresha.

Robert Rwakabogo umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe iyamamazabikorwa muri MTN Rwanda yagize ati “Turashaka guha abaturarwanda bose kuva ku bakomeye cyane nk’ibigo binini bishobora gukoresha internet cyane kugeza ku muturage wo hasi woroheje ushobora gukoresha internet ku giti cye, amahirwe yo kumenya akamaro ka internet mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Birashoboka ko wenda bazagira ikibazo ko nta mafaanga babona ariko uzaba yamaze gusobanukirwa n’iyi gahunda akemera kuyikoresha tuzamuha igihe cy’ukwezi kumwe cyangwa abiri cya internet y’ubuntu maze abanze arebe neza icyo izamumarira.”

Robert Rwakabogo asobanura iby'iyi gahunda

MTN Rwanda ikaba imaze iminsi ishyize imbaraga cyane mu gufasha abantu mu mikoreshereze ya internet aho mu minsi ishize yashyize hanze gahunda nyinshi zorohereza abantu kuyikoresha harimo Social Pack ibafasha gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga na Facebook, WhatsApp na Twiter ku giciro gito cyane, gusura urubua rwa Wikipedia ku buntu, 0 Facebook n’izindi nyinshi.

Asante Ebenezer umuyobozi mukuru wa MTN Rwanda

Aya mezi 2 rero MTN Rwanda ikaba yatumye intumwa zayo mu bice bitandukanye cyane cyane ahakunze guhurira abantu bensho nko mu magare y’imodoka, mu muhanda no mu biro ahakorera bensho batandukanye ndetse no mu duce abantu batuyemo aho bazagenda basobanurira abantu iby’iyi gahunda.

Mu kiganiro na Platini ubarizwa mu itsinda rya Dream Boys, yadutangarije ko mu byukuri bahisemo gushyira hanze iyi ndirimbo muri Gicurasi 2019 kuko mu mwaka wa 2018 ubwo waganaga ku musozo mu Ukuboza aribwo bashyize hanze indirimbo bise”Niko ye”, Platini yatangarije umunyamakuru iyo bayikurikiza indi byari ukuba biciye iyo baherukaga gukora bitewe nuko babonye abantu bayakiriye.

Nemeye Platini wagiranye ikiganiro na Inyarwanda yatangaje ko mu byukuri uyu mwaka wa 2019 ari uwo gukora cyane bityo ngo muri uyu mwaka iri tsinda rigomba gushyira hanze indirimbo nyinshi ku buryo abakunzi babo batazicwa n’irungu.Platini yatangaje ko bafite umubare munini w’indirimbo bamaze gutunganya zisigaje kujya hanze imwe ku yindi.

Iyi ndirimbo nshya ya Dream Boys “Nkabura amahoro” mu buryo bw’amajwi yakozwe na Producer Madebeat mu gihe amashusho yayo yo yafashwe akanatunganywa na Bagenzi Bernard bamwe mu bagabo bari gukora cyane mu gutunganya indirimbo hano mu Rwanda.

title: CNLG yamaganiye kure abakwirakwiza imvugo zih...
content:
Komisiyo y’Igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG), yamaganiye kure abakwirakwiza imvugo zihembera amacakubiri ashingiye ku moko (Hutu-Tutsi) bitwikiriye irushanwa rya Miss Rwanda. Iyi Komisiyo ivuga ko imvugo zisebanya, zuzuye ivangura arizo zahembereye amacakubiri n’ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside byagejeje kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.

Mu itangazo,CNLG, yanyujije ku rukuta rwa Twitter, kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 25 Mutarama 2019, yamaganye abitwikira Miss Rwanda bagahembera imvugo zibiba amacakubiri. Yasabye abantu gushyira hamwe hisunzwe indangagaciro y’ubunyarwanda. Yongeraho ko imvugo zisebanya, zuzuye ivanguro arizo zagejeje u Rwanda kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994.

CNLG yagize iti: “Komisiyo y’Igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG) iramagana imvugo yuzuye ivangura rigamije gukwirakwiza amacakubiri ashingiye ku moko ya Hutu/Tutsi no kugaragaza ko hari ubwoko buruta ubundi. Mu Rwanda ntitukiri igihugu kirangwa n’amacakubiri ashingiye ku moko."

“Mu gikorwa cya Nyampinga w’u Rwanda kiri kuba dukwiriye gushyira hamwe hitawe ku ndangagaciro y’ubunyarwanda aho kugendera ku moko Hutu/Tutsi Imvugo zisebanya, zuzuye ivangura nizo zahembereye amacakubiri n’ingengabitecyerezo ya Jenoside byatugejeje kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi.”

“Rimwe mu mahame rangashingiro y’Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda mu ngingo ya cumi (10) ni ukurandura ivangura, amacakubiri n’ingengabitecyerezo ya Jenoside himakazwa ubumwe.”

“Imvugo zihembera amacakubiri zimaze iminsi zinyuzwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zihabanye cyane n’ihame rangashingiro ryavuzwe mbere ndetse n’andi mahame no gutesha agaciro Abanyarwanda.CNLG yibukije ibikorwa byo bikorerwa mu ruhame bihamije ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside bihanirwa.

“CNLG iributsa ko imvugo n’ibikorwa byose bikorewe mu ruhame bigamije guhembera ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside gupfobya no guhakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 bihanwa n’itegeko no 59/2018 ryo 22/8/2018 rihana icyaha cy’ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside n’ibyaha bifitanye isano.”

CNLG isohoye iri tangazo nyuma y’uko hari abagiye bandika ibitekerezo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Facebook na Twitter bavuga ko Mwiseneza Josiane ariwe ukwiriye kuba Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2019, gusa ni ubutumwa buba burimo amagambo ahembera amacakubiri.

Yizeraga ko urukundo Christian akunda Alide rurimo ibinyoma ndetse akaba ashaka kuzababaza Alide kurushaho. Christian akimara kumva inkuru yari abwiwe na Juru, yahise yumva yakwihagurukira akigendera. Christian yibutse ukuntu bakiri bato, Bosco yakoze icyo ashoboye cyose ngo abere Alide ingabo imukingira kandi ngo yigarurire umutima we, ahita akeka ko uko byagenda kose Bosco yaje gukundana na Alide birakomera ku kigero cy’uko Juru yabahimbiye inkuru nk’iyo. Yibutse ukuntu Alide yahangayitse ubwo Bosco yafungwaga, ahita abona ko Alide agikunda Bosco cyane. Yahise yibwira muri we ati:

“Yego uriya mukobwa mukunda nta kintu ngendeyeho pe. Ahari wenda nubwo we abura amahitamo agapfa kunkunda mu rwego rwo kurinda isezerano yampaye, reka ibi mbikorere umwana wanjye Baho.”

Christian yahise asohora umwuka, ariruhutsa nuko ahita abwira Juru ati:

“Ese muvandi ibi byose uri kubikora kugira ngo urebe kwihangana kwanjye. Ndabyumva mu nkuru yawe, washakaga kumbwira ko mushiki wawe na Bosco bakundana, ku kigero cy’uko umwe yakwitangira undi. Ibyo nanjye ndabibona, yewe nta nubwo mbihakanye pe. Ariko niba hari inshingano imwe nkora mu rukundo rwanjye na Alide, ni ukumurekera amahitamo ye, kandi nkamukunda bizira uburyarya. Juru erega ntabwo arinjye ufite igisubizo cy’ikibazo uhora wibaza.”

Juru – “Ikihe kibazo mpora nibaza se?”

Christian – “Wibaza impamvu mushiki wawe akomeza kunkunda kandi wowe ubona ntashobotse. Wibaza impamvu Alide na Bosco badasubirana kandi bigaragara ko buri umwe akiyumvamo undi. Ese ntabwo ibyo ari byo bibazo wibaza kandi bikaba ari na byo bitumye turi kumwe hano? Impamvu turi kumwe hano, ni uko wumva ko hari icyo nakora ngo ibintu bigende nk’uko ubyifuriza mushiki wawe. Ese mwa uragira ngo mbigenze nte njyewe? Ese ngende mbwire Alide nti “Ndakwanze, ndabona gukomezanya nawe bitagishobotse sanga Bosco?” Oya! Ibyo ntabwo nabirota mwana. Njyewe inshingano yanjye ni ukuba umukunzi wifuzwa na Alide, mu gihe tugikundana. Urumva rero, aho kunshakiraho impamvu, genda ubaze mushiki wawe icyo yemeranya n’umutima we. Naho njyewe ntabwo nagambanira isezerano namuhaye ryo kumukunda kuko ubivuze.”

Christian akimara kubwira Juru gutyo, yahise ahaguruka aragenda gusa atari yagera imbere aragaruka abwira Juru ati:

“Alide ndamukunda kandi nta buryarya burimo. Niba utizera ibyo mvuze ugerageze kubaza abanzi neza, Alide ni we mukunzi wa mbere ngize. Ntabwo ndya abana cyangwa ngo mbe ndi umuhehesi nk’uko ubikeka. Bro irinde gufatira imyanzuro ibyo amaso yawe akwereka. Koresha umutimanama wawe kandi ujye wishyira mu mwanya w’umuntu mbere yo kumucira urubanza.”

Juru yasigaye aho yumiwe. Yahise ahamagara Bosco mu kanya gato aba amusanze aho. Bosco yahageze asanga Juru ameze nk’uwihebye nuko ahita amubaza ati:

“Mwana ufite ikihe kibazo ko mbona agahinda kakwishe.”

Juru – “Ariko ubundi ndinda gusazwa n’ibintu byawe na Alide, ni gute mwebwe babiri mwananiwe kubyikemurira. Icara wumve isanganya mpuriye na ryo hano.”

Bosco yahise yicara n’amatsiko menshi nuko aratuza ategereza ko Juru agira ikintu amubwira. Hashize umwanya Juru yifashe ku mutwe ahita abwira Bosco ati:

“Harya uriya muginga ngo ni Christian ubundi ahahise he … oya nako.”

Bosco – “Ariko se man bigenze gute kuki utambwira?”

Juru – “Ntabwo wakumva ukuntu uriya muginga ari umuhanga. Uzi ko ubu numva nta kosa afite. Anyumvishije ukuntu akunda mushiki wanjye kandi ko adashobora kwifata ngo yange Alide. Ahubwo Alide we biramutse bimuturutseho, nibwo ibintu byajya mu buryo. Man Bosco bisa nkaho Juru ananiwe ahasigaye ari ahawe.”

Bosco yahise yumva bimubabaje nuko abwira Juru ati:

“Man nakubwiye ukuntu Alide ameze. Nanjye ndabibona ko akinkunda gusa uriya ni umukobwa wizirika ku isezerano. Biragoye kuba yakwanga Christian nta kintu bapfuye kandi ni cyo kintu kigomba kuba gikomeye.”

Juru – “Reka iherezo rizagene uko ibintu bizagenda. Niba Alide yararemewe kuba uwawe, azaba uwawe nta kabuza, kandi niba atari uwawe, tangira uterete Rachel bikiri mu maguru mashya.”

Babuze nibyo baganira nuko bageraho baratandukana. Christian yaje kugera i Butare asanga Cyiza aramutegereje. Yari afite amatsiko yo kumva uko urugendo rwe rwagenze gusa Christina yarabanje ajya koga ahita ahitira mu buriri. Yageze mu buriri abura ibitotsi nuko ahita ahamagara Cyiza amusanga mu cyumba. Bicaye ku buriri nuko Christian atangira kumubwira amajya yeee biratinda. Yamubwiye uko yambitse Alide impeta, nyuma akaza kuyimusubiza, gusa akongera akayimwambika. Cyiza yarumiwe nuko Christian akomeza kumubwira ibyamubayeho uwo munsi ubwo yahuraga na Juru mbese amubwira byose. Christian yahise avuga ati:

“Muvandi, ubu nanjye ntabwo nzi icyo gukora pe aho bigeze nkwiye kureka Alide akazahitamo, nanjye ngakurikira amahitamo ye.”

Cyiza – “Naho se umwana wawe Baho akazamenya ko uri se gute?”

Christian – “Uriya mwana ni umumalayika man. Aho kugira ngo amenye ko ari umwana wavukiye mu gikomere… nako ibyo azabimenye, ariko ndumva ko atari ngombwa ko amenya se wangije ubuzima bwa nyina. Ibyo kutabimenya, nibyo byamubera byiza, kandi kugira ngo atabimenya, na nyina akwiye kubihishwa. Alide naramuka abaye uwanjye, bizanshimisha, ariko nabwo naramuka atananyemeye, nzatuza mwana. Nzabaho nk’umuntu wirinze kubaho uko yifuza kugira ngo yifurize ubuzima bwiza abo akunda. Alide ndamukunda cyane kandi si uko yambyariye Baho gusa.”

Cyiza – “Bro ndumva ntazi icyo kukubwira pe, gusa tuza, ahazaza hazagene ibyo wateganyirijwe n’Imana. Yego kera wari undi wundi, ariko ubu uri mushya kandi ubaho ubuzima bufite intego. Wakunze Alide utamuzi, ndetse kuba mugenda muhura muri ubu buryo, wasanga ari uko Imana ifite icyo ibahishiye mu hazaza hanyu. Wasanga n’ibi ari igihano Imana igenda iguha ku bw’icyaha wigeze gukora. Ikindi kandi witegure ibizakubaho ubwo Alide azavumbura uwo uri we.”

Juru ku rundi ruhande, yari yahise ajya kwa Pasiteri nuko asaba Alide ko yamuha iminota mike bakavugana. Bafashe udutebe batujyana ku irembo nuko Juru ahita abaza Alide ati:

“Ali ndagusabye, unsubize iki kibazo pe kandi unsubizanye ukuri kwawe kose ndetse n’ubupfura n’ubunyangamugayo bwawe bwose.”

Alide – “Mbaza nta kibazo. Ariko se ni ubuhoro?”

Juru – “Nakubwiye kenshi ko Bosco ari inshuti yanjye y’akadasohoka. Ni umunywanyi wanjye, rero ibibazo bye nibyo byanjye mwana. Rero niba ahangayitse, nanjye ntabwo ntuje.”

Alide – “Ariko se bite? None se Bosco afite ikihe kibazo? Sha mbwira vuba ngende.”

Juru – “Noneho ufite aho ugiye se?”

Alide – “Yego. Nsubiye mu Ntara, nzagaruka ngiye gutangira ishuri.”

Juru – “Bosco ikibazo afite kandi ari cyo mfite, urakizi. Ahora yibaza koko niba umukunda cyangwa niba utamukunda. None Ali nshaka kukubaza mu by’ukuri Bosco uramukunda cyangwa…?”

Alide yatinze gusubiza nuko Juru ahita yongera aramubwira ati:

“Kandi ubu wasanga uri gutekereza ku kuntu ugiye kumbeshya. Icyo ni ikibazo kiba gikeneye yego cyangwa oya, nta bindi bisobanuro. Rero nsubiza kandi mu ijambo rigizwe n’imigemo ibiri.”

Juru – “Ye?? Ubwo ushatse kuvuga iki? Ali ukunda Bosco?”

Alide – “Yego. Bosco ndamukunda!”

Juru – “Ariko njyewe ntabwo byumva rwose. Niba ukunda Bosco, kuki ukomeza kumurebera anyura mu mihangayiko yose aterwa nuko mudakundana? Ese kuki mudakunda, harabura iki Ali? kuki ukomeza kwizirika kuri Christian udakunda kandi Bosco wamaze ubuzima bwe bwose nta wundi mukobwa atekereza, ahari? Kuki?”

title: Imbuga nkoranyambaga, isoko ryahiriye abakora ibijyanye n’imideri mu Rwanda
content:
Imbuga Nkoranyambaga zikomeje guhindura imibereho y’abatuye Isi muri iki gihe, bamwe bazikoresha mu bucuruzi abandi bakazifashisha bagaragaza ibyo bakora no gusangiza abandi ubuzima babayemo. Abakora ibijyanye n’Imideri mu Rwanda bo ryabaguriye isoko ubu bazikoresha mu kureshya abaguzi.

Minisiteri y’Ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho na Inovasiyo ivuga ko abagerwagaho na murandasi mu Rwanda muri 2011 bari 7% ubu bakaba bageze kuri 52%.

Iyi minisiteri itangaza ko muri 2010 abari batunze telefone ngendanwa bari 33% mu gihe mu mwaka ushize bazamutse bakikuba zirenga ebyiri kuko bageze kuri 80.5%

Kuzamuka kw’iyi mibare kwafashije cyane abari mu ruganda rw’imideri mu Rwanda kuko bakoresha iri koranabuhanga mu kwerekana ibyo bakora na byo bikagera kuri benshi kubera izamuka ry’abazikoresha.

Inzu nyinshi z’imideri, abategura ibitaramo by’imideri, abamurika imideri, abajyanama mu by’imyambarire n’abahanga imideri ku giti cyabo bakunze gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga nk’inzira ifunguye yabafashaga gukurura abakiriya no kwerekana bimwe mu bikorwa bakora.

Zimzwe muri izi nzu z’imideri zifite abazikurikira cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nk’iyitwa Uzuri K&Y ikurikirwa n’abarenga ibihumbi 15 kuri Instagram, kuri Twitter bagakurikirwa n’abarenga 1 000, mu gihe kuri facebook bakurikirwa n’abarenga ibihumbi 43.

Tanga Designs bakurikirwa n’abarenga ibihumbi 19 kuri instagram, kuri twitter bakurikirwa n’abarenga 800, mugihe Sonia Mugabo akurikirwa n’abarenga ibihumbi 27 kuri Instagram naho kuri twitter agakurikirwa n’abarenga 7 000.

Usibye izi nzu z’imideri, n’abategura ibitaramo by’imideri bakunze gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga kuko akenshi ari na zo bahamagariramo abantu kuzitabira ibitaramo baba bariho bategura cyangwa bakerekaniraho uko ibyamaze kuba byagiye bigenda.

Kigali Fashion Week ni igitaramo kimaze kumenyekana mu Rwanda dore ko ubu cyanabaye mpuzamahanga, kikaba gisigaye kibera mu bihugu bitandukanye. Kuri instagram bakurikirwa n’abarenga ibihumbi bibiri, kuri facebook bagakurikirwa n’abarenga ibihumbi bine.

Mercedes Benz Fashion week Kigali na cyo ni ikindi gitaramo cyatangiye gutegurwa umwaka ushize kugera ubu gikurikirwa n’abarenga 800 kuri instagram. Collective Rw fashion week ikurikirwa n’abarenga ibihumbi bine kuri instagram, kuri twitter ho bakurikirwa n’abarenga ibihumbi bibiri.

Abacuruza imyambaro isanzwe nabo bakomeje kuzamuka mu gukoresha iri koranabuhanga ry’imbuga nkoranyambaga.

Aba bose bakora ibifite aho bihuriye n’imideri bakunze no gukora ibiganiro bitandukanye bica kuri channel zitandukanye kuri Youtube zaba izabo bwite cyangwa bagakorana n’itangazamakuru bikomeye ku Isi nka BBC na CNN by’umwihariko ibi bitangazamakuru bibiri byafashije uru rwego rw’imideri kumenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahang.

Usibye BBC na CNN n’ibindi bitangazamakuru byo mu Rwanda birimo Umuseke bikunze gutangaza amakuru agaruka ku buzima bwa buri munsi bw’abari mu mideri.

Ndayishimiye Daniel utegura igitaramo cya Mercedes Benz Fashion Week Kigali yabwiye Umuseke ko amakuru menshi y’ibirebana n’imideri ayakura ku mbuga nkoranyambaga by’umwihariko kuri we ngo ni indi nzira akunze gukoresha yamamaza ibikorwa by’iki gitaramo ategura.

Ati “Nko muri Africa y’Iburengerazuba usanga abakora ibifite aho bihuriye n’imideri bakoresha cyane imbuga nkoranyambaga kuko hari n’ababisaruramo amafaranga Atari make.”

Akomeza agira ati “Hari n’abashabikira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga batangaza amakuru y’imideri aba bazwi nk’aba ‘fashion blogger’ kandi aba akenshi usanga bubashywe cyane mu bihugu byabo kuko hari ikintu kinini bongerera uruganda rw’imideri mu bihugu byabo.”

Sarah Nynthia washinze ikigo kimenyekanisha abamurika imideri ku masoko mpuzamahanga cya ‘webest model’ avuga ko imbuga nkoranyambaga bazikoresha bashaka akazi.

Ati “Nk’ubu dukorana n’ibigo bindi biciye kuri murandasi yaba ibyo muri Africa y’Epfo, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za America, u Bufaransa n’ahandi. Aha hose duhererakanya amakuru n’imyitwarire y’abamurika imideri bityo bikatworohereza no kubona akazi.”

Kugeza ubu umwe mu bamurika imideri bo muri Webest model witwa Isheja Morella yatumiwe kujya kumurika imideri muri Milan Fashion Week kizaba ku wa 18-24 Gashyantare 2020 na Paris Fashion Week izaba ku wa 4 Werurwe 2020.
